visual_reviewed_images.observed: Gazette issue heading and Decision 249 title

important_limits: Images are secondary reproductions of Gazette pages and carry an Almasdar watermark; they are not the original Amiri Press PDF.
Article/table summaries are discovery notes, not verified operative text or complete transcription.
All thresholds, staffing numbers, meeting periods, repeal details and effective-date wording require original Gazette comparison.
No candidate is approved for authoritative legal retrieval or workplace compliance use.

records.title: Definitions
records.summary_candidate_arabic_source: Secondary visual reproduction; see page image locators.
records.summary_candidate_en: Definitions include establishment, high/medium/limited risk, blind spots, safe driving, ministry, competent authority and Labour Law 14/2025.

records.title: Applicability and workforce threshold
records.summary_candidate_arabic_source: Secondary visual reproduction; see page image locators.
records.summary_candidate_en: Applies to establishments/branches with 50 or more workers irrespective of work nature or employment relationship; geographically/administratively separate worksites are treated separately where the stated threshold is met.

records.title: Employer/management duties
records.summary_candidate_arabic_source: Secondary visual reproduction; see page image locators.
records.summary_candidate_en: Multi-part duties covering safe workplace, OSH policy, legal compliance, resources, responsibilities, training, monitoring, emergency readiness and accident/occupational-disease prevention.

records.title: OSH functional unit establishment and staffing
records.summary_candidate_arabic_source: Secondary visual reproduction; see page image locators.
records.summary_candidate_en: Requires an OSH functional unit in the establishments/branches covered by Article 2 (50 or more workers), with staffing numbers determined by risk category and workforce under Table 2.

records.title: Functional unit responsibilities
records.summary_candidate_arabic_source: Secondary visual reproduction; see page image locators.
records.summary_candidate_en: Detailed operational duties for OSH policy, standards, inspections, hazard control, emergency planning, incident review, training and reporting.

records.title: Requirements for certain smaller establishments
records.summary_candidate_arabic_source: Secondary visual reproduction; see page image locators.
records.summary_candidate_en: Provides alternative requirements for certain establishments below 50 workers, differentiated by risk category; exact eligibility/training/supervision requirements need table and text matching.

records.title: OSH committee formation and duties
records.summary_candidate_arabic_source: Secondary visual reproduction; see page image locators.
records.summary_candidate_en: Sets committee composition and a broad remit to examine working conditions, incidents, hazards, controls and OSH improvement.

records.title: Notification of committee formation/changes
records.summary_candidate_arabic_source: Secondary visual reproduction; see page image locators.
records.summary_candidate_en: Requires notification of committee formation or membership changes to the competent labour/OSH authority.

records.title: Committee meeting frequency and emergency meetings
records.summary_candidate_arabic_source: Secondary visual reproduction; see page image locators.
records.summary_candidate_en: Requires at least monthly meetings for medium/high-risk establishments and at least every two months for limited-risk establishments; also requires a meeting within 48 hours after a serious accident or confirmed occupational disease.

records.title: Committee quorum and voting
records.summary_candidate_arabic_source: Secondary visual reproduction; see page image locators.
records.summary_candidate_en: Sets attendance/quorum and voting rules for committee decisions.

records.title: Submission of agenda items/proposals
records.summary_candidate_arabic_source: Secondary visual reproduction; see page image locators.
records.summary_candidate_en: Members submit written/electronic proposals before the scheduled meeting for inclusion in the agenda.

records.title: Committee minutes and records
records.summary_candidate_arabic_source: Secondary visual reproduction; see page image locators.
records.summary_candidate_en: Requires a committee record/minutes register with prescribed identification and recordkeeping.

records.title: Notification/filing of committee minutes
records.summary_candidate_arabic_source: Secondary visual reproduction; see page image locators.
records.summary_candidate_en: Requires the committee report/minutes to be notified or filed with the competent OSH office.

records.title: Replacement of repeatedly absent members
records.summary_candidate_arabic_source: Secondary visual reproduction; see page image locators.
records.summary_candidate_en: Provides for replacement of a member after repeated consecutive absences without acceptable excuse.

records.title: Central OSH committee
records.summary_candidate_arabic_source: Secondary visual reproduction; see page image locators.
records.summary_candidate_en: Establishes a central committee structure at governorate/republic level and describes its membership/oversight.

records.title: Qualifications of OSH specialists
records.summary_candidate_arabic_source: Secondary visual reproduction; see page image locators.
records.summary_candidate_en: Sets qualifications for OSH specialists in covered establishments, with reference to Table 1 and the decision's training provisions.

records.title: Qualifications of OSH supervisors
records.summary_candidate_arabic_source: Secondary visual reproduction; see page image locators.
records.summary_candidate_en: Sets qualification/experience/training requirements for OSH supervisors in covered establishments.

records.title: Qualifications for OSH roles in other covered establishments
records.summary_candidate_arabic_source: Secondary visual reproduction; see page image locators.
records.summary_candidate_en: Sets role-specific qualification requirements for OSH staff in establishments covered by the relevant risk category.

records.title: Training of OSH personnel and related roles
records.summary_candidate_arabic_source: Secondary visual reproduction; see page image locators.
records.summary_candidate_en: Requires training for OSH specialists/supervisors, committee members and relevant management/production personnel.

records.title: Training providers and training progression
records.summary_candidate_arabic_source: Secondary visual reproduction; see page image locators.
records.summary_candidate_en: Describes ministry/national-centre/licensed training provision and basic/advanced/specialist training requirements.

records.title: Repeal of prior ministerial decision
records.summary_candidate_arabic_source: Secondary visual reproduction; see page image locators.
records.summary_candidate_en: Appears to repeal Ministerial Decision 134/2003 concerning establishments required to establish OSH units/committees; confirm exact number, title and scope against original Gazette.

records.title: Publication and commencement
records.summary_candidate_arabic_source: Secondary visual reproduction; see page image locators.
records.summary_candidate_en: States commencement on the day following publication; reproduced page shows decision signed/issued 2026-09-01. Based on Gazette publication 2026-10-12, 2026-10-13 is a candidate effective date, pending original Gazette confirmation.
records.date_calculation_note: Candidate only: publication 2026-10-12; Article 22 says day following publication. Confirm original Gazette date and exact wording.

records.title: Risk classification of establishments and activities
records.summary_candidate_arabic_source: Secondary visual reproduction; see page image locators.
records.summary_candidate_en: Classifies establishments/activities as high, medium or limited risk across multiple sectors. Requires cell-by-cell extraction; do not substitute broad sector labels for the detailed list.

records.title: OSH staffing levels by risk/workforce
records.summary_candidate_arabic_source: Secondary visual reproduction; see page image locators.
records.summary_candidate_en: Specifies required numbers of specialists, supervisors and technicians by risk category and workforce band. Safety-critical table; transcribe every cell and footnote.

records.title: Activities requiring continuous monitoring
records.summary_candidate_arabic_source: Secondary visual reproduction; see page image locators.
records.summary_candidate_en: Lists activities and corresponding pollutants/hazards to monitor. Preserve exact chemical abbreviations, units and associations.

records.title: High-risk classification criteria
records.summary_candidate_arabic_source: Secondary visual reproduction; see page image locators.
records.summary_candidate_en: Lists criteria such as process nature, hazardous materials, establishment/workforce size, electrical/mechanical risks, environmental/biological hazards and fire/explosion potential.
